topic: नई आदत शुरू करने में अगर-तब योजना कैसे मदद कर सकती है?
working_title_hi: नई आदत शुरू नहीं हो रही? लक्ष्य नहीं, अगर-तब योजना बनाइए

scientific_evidence: A goal intention alone does not guarantee action.
Implementation intentions specify a cue and response in an if-then format.
Such plans can support noticing a selected cue and initiating a planned action.
practical_behavioral_strategy: Choose one realistic recurring cue and a small feasible response.
not_claimed: An if-then plan does not guarantee goal attainment or automatic habit formation.
The content is not medical or mental-health treatment advice.
